description:
Get your child ready for an exciting ride with the GlareWheel GWES-Y5 Kids Go Kart E-Scooter — designed for fun, safety, and durability.

Sturdy Frame: Steel construction with a full enclosed base for stability and safety.

Powerful Motor: 350W rear dual drive motor delivers smooth acceleration and climbing ability.

Battery Options: 6V 4.5Ah / 6V 6Ah rechargeable battery for up to 60 minutes of playtime.

Safe Braking: Rear mechanical disc brake with power-cut function for reliable stopping.

Comfort & Control: Realistic racing steering wheel with music, lights, and easy-to-use controls.

Smooth Ride: 16-inch EVA foam tires provide grip and shock absorption on multiple road surfaces.

Kid-Friendly Design: Low center of gravity for better balance, max speed 6 mph, max load 110 lbs.

With its sleek design, fun entertainment features, and strong performance, the GWES-Y5 lets kids experience their racing dreams safely and in style.
